name: tapalog-reader
description: A single-file server that turns a folder of books (PDF, EPUB, FB2, DJVU, CBZ, MOBI, TXT, ecatm) into a web library with built-in readers.

scripts.compile:linux-x64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/server/main.compiled.linux-x64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-reader-linux-x64
scripts.compile:linux-arm64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts linux-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 src/server/main.compiled.linux-arm64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-reader-linux-arm64
scripts.compile:macos-arm64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/server/main.compiled.darwin-arm64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-reader-macos-arm64
scripts.compile:macos-x64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/server/main.compiled.darwin-x64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-reader-macos-x64
scripts.compile:windows-x64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts windows-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-hide-console --windows-icon=assets/icon.ico src/server/main.compiled.windows-x64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-reader-windows-x64.exe
